claim_boundary: Planner-SFT data path evidence only. This does not claim a trained planner-quality improvement or a predicted-planner SQL execution win.
change: Added data.planner_sft to materialize planner supervised-finetuning rows from prepared train split turns.
The planner prompt contains only system/user context; assistant SQL history is removed from the planner prompt.
The normalized gold plan is visible only as the assistant training target, not inside the prompt.
verification: uv run --active --no-sync pytest tests/test_planner_sft.py tests/test_eval_planner_predict.py tests/test_eval_planner_eval.py
Sample rows were checked to ensure no assistant messages appear before the target assistant plan.
interpretation: Checkpoint 5 can now train or tune a planner on train-split labels without adding scorer-side gold plans to inference prompts.
Planner readiness remains unproven until a trained or prompted planner is evaluated on held-out proxy and clean-holdout rows with eval.planner_eval and eval.planner_readiness.
Do not run eval.run_predicted_planner_comparison until held-out planner readiness passes.
